title: Handle E-stop condition after RMS shutdown (release E-stop / site release)
summary: If RMS is shut down and an E-stop appears, the E-stop must be released (either by the support team or by site release) so the system can resume.
when_to_use: Use when RMS has been shut down and the system comes up with an E-stop condition.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Coordinate the E-stop release action and confirm the system is no longer in the E-stop condition after RMS shutdown.
Site (site release): Release the E-stop when site performs the release as described by the source.
safety_notes: Treat the E-stop as a safety condition that must be released before resuming normal operation.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the E-stop release control/indicator (as described in the source context)
Ability to coordinate with site for E-stop release if required

access_required: Access to the E-stop release control/indicator (as described in the source context)

steps.title: Confirm E-stop is present after RMS shutdown
steps.purpose: Verify the E-stop condition is the one that appears as a result of RMS shutdown so the correct recovery action (release) is taken.
steps.instruction: On the live RMS-related controls/indication, confirm that an E-stop is currently present following the RMS shutdown event.
steps.expected_result: An E-stop indication is present after RMS shutdown.
steps.healthy_condition: E-stop indication is clearly visible as active (i.e., the system is in an E-stop condition) immediately after RMS shutdown.
steps.failure_condition: No E-stop indication is present, or the E-stop condition cannot be confirmed on the live controls/indicator.

actions.label: Check E-stop indication
actions.exact_action: Confirm that an E-stop appears after shutting down RMS

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot confirm the E-stop condition on the live controls/indicator, stop and escalate for further safety/system investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Speaker says if you shut down RMS it comes up with an E stop, so you have to release the E stop or have site released the E stop.

steps.title: Release the E-stop (or coordinate site release)
steps.purpose: Clear the E-stop condition so the system can resume after RMS shutdown.
steps.instruction: Release the E-stop. If the source indicates the site performs the release, coordinate with site to release the E-stop.
steps.expected_result: E-stop is released after RMS shutdown so the system is no longer in the E-stop condition.
steps.healthy_condition: E-stop indication is no longer active after the release action (either performed by support or by site).
steps.failure_condition: E-stop cannot be released and remains active.

actions.label: Release E-stop
actions.exact_action: Release the E-stop or have site released the E-stop

stop_or_escalate_if: If the E-stop cannot be released, escalate to appropriate support for further safety/system investigation.
